items.question: What are the defining attributes of the sixth cakra in this sequence?
premises: The sixth cakra is introduced as the next in sequence.
It is characterized as a king.
It is described as having eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is identified as a regal, eight-petaled center possessing a pericarp.
uncertainties: The specific symbolic meaning of rājānam in this context is not explicitly defined.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the king, having eight petals and a pericarp.
